# Daily Report — 2026-08-02

## Task Completed
Added `list_change_request_tasks` shortcut tool to `change_tools.py`. This tool wraps the
change_task table query scoped to a single change request and offers three additional filters
(`state`, `priority`, `assigned_to`) that the existing `list_change_tasks` tool does not
expose. Results are passed through `_format_change_task` so all reference fields are
normalised to display values and the response shape is consistent with `get_change_task`.
Registered in `__init__.py`, `tool_utils.py`, and in both the `change_coordinator` and
`full` package definitions in `config/tool_packages.yaml`.
